output.reason: A 65-year-old with type 2 diabetes reports glucose over 400 today with repeated vomiting and inability to keep water down, a hyperglycemic crisis picture (DKA or hyperosmolar state) needing immediate IV fluids, labs and insulin that messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Very high sugar with vomiting and being unable to keep water down can mean a dangerous diabetic emergency needing IV fluids, blood tests and insulin today. Do not drive yourself — have someone take you, or call 911 if you feel faint, confused, drowsy, have trouble breathing or worsening belly pain. Keep sipping only if you can; don't delay going.
